instructions.title: Complete Drone Flight Operations Briefing
instructions.message: Proceed to the Mission Control Navigation station.
instructions.guidance: Review the target submitted during Sol 3, the Sol 4 preparation report, the 1.5 km by 1.5 km gameplay boundary, the 10 m AGL ceiling, the existing takeoff and landing reference, and the five-image requirement. These flight values describe the PHOBOSIA simulation.
instructions.activity: Explicitly confirm the complete preflight briefing. Opening this interface alone does not complete the task.

instructions.title: Activate Drone Reconnaissance Simulation
instructions.message: Remain at the Mission Control Navigation station.
instructions.guidance: Activate the simulation only after the target and Sol 4 preparation record validate and the existing drone, takeoff reference, and matching target scene object resolve.
instructions.activity: Use the existing Mission Control OS action to transfer control into the drone camera simulation.

instructions.title: Conduct Aerial Route Reconnaissance
instructions.message: Operate the drone over the Mars terrain scene.
instructions.guidance: Use W/A/S/D for horizontal flight, E/Q for altitude, mouse movement for camera look, and keys 1–5 for the front, rear, left, right, and downward views. Stay inside the displayed gameplay boundary and below 10 m AGL. Capture at least five non-empty images with C.
instructions.activity: Capture live camera images and return to the designated takeoff marker. The simulation does not claim NASA flight-controller fidelity.

instructions.title: Return and Safely Land the Drone
instructions.guidance: Reduce horizontal motion, descend close to the takeoff surface, and initiate landing with L only when position, AGL, speed, and image-count checks pass. The simulation will not teleport the drone or validate an incomplete image set.
instructions.activity: Press L or use the landing control to request the explicit landing validation.

instructions.title: Review Aerial Observation Records
instructions.message: Return to the Mission Control Navigation station after landing.
instructions.guidance: Inspect each saved preview and its position, altitude, heading, elapsed time, camera view, and official target reference. Do not treat a player interpretation as an automated scientific finding.
instructions.activity: Confirm the saved images have been reviewed before preparing the report.

instructions.title: Submit Sol 5 Aerial Reconnaissance Report
instructions.message: Submit the report at the Mission Control Navigation station.
instructions.guidance: Report actual simulation status and metrics, describe visible image features in your own words, distinguish interpretation and uncertainty, and identify areas for Sol 6 ground verification. Missing values must remain unavailable.
instructions.activity: Submit the target-linked report after image review. Return to Habitat Rest Area to conclude Sol 5.

completion.title: Sol 5 Aerial Reconnaissance Complete
completion.message: The target-linked report is saved. Return to Habitat Rest Area and use the existing rest interaction to begin the next mission day.
